subject.title: [TUI] Scroll-jump / auto-scroll behavior is still disruptive in 2026.3.8

question: Should TUI auto-follow be fixed as renderer behavior only, exposed as a user-visible TUI mode or setting, or both?
rationale: Source inspection supports a credible TUI render path, but changing terminal follow behavior affects default UX and may add a new persisted or interactive setting, so automation should not pick the product shape alone.

options.title: Set TUI anchoring policy plus visible control
options.body: Add a TUI-owned near-bottom/off/always or equivalent mode with live PTY proof, while keeping browser WebChat settings separate.

options.title: Fix only renderer jump behavior
options.body: Patch or bump the renderer path so content-driven redraws do not disrupt scrollback, without adding a user-facing TUI setting.

options.title: Wait for narrower scrollback fix first
options.body: Resolve the open long-message scrollback-clearing issue first, then revisit this broader auto-follow request with fresh terminal proof.

recommendation.title: Set TUI anchoring policy plus visible control
recommendation.body: Add a TUI-owned near-bottom/off/always or equivalent mode with live PTY proof, while keeping browser WebChat settings separate.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue needs TUI product-shape direction, and recent path history shows steipete touching TUI docs and refresh behavior adjacent to this decision.
